thread:
alex: Heads-up: planning an RBAC refactor to split org -> project scopes tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need a quick audit logging + KMS-binding review — migration could accidentally grant enumerate/read across sibling projects.
priya: Can you paste the migration plan? worried about legacy service-accounts with org-level roles.
alex: Pasting the planned mapping snippet:
```yaml
# migration mapping (draft)
org.viewer: project.viewer
org.editor: project.editor
org.service-account: project.service-account
# TODO: ensure explicit project:<id> scoping
```
marta: We need pre/post binding snapshots in the audit logs + actor identity. Otherwise we can't prove there wasn't a leak. Sec team can add an ingestion rule to capture old->new binding diffs.
dan: quick grep in prod config: legacy binding `org.viewer` is still attached to svcacc `svc-ingest`. Mapping that to project.viewer would give it read on ALL sibling projects unless we scope to project:id.
alex: Good catch. I'll update mapping to require explicit `project:<id>` scoping and add a migration dry-run.
sec-bot: ALERT: stale KMS alias detected in prod org 42 — alias `rw-main-kms` points to deprecated key version v1. Recommend rotation before major role changes. (auto-scan)
priya: Rotation steps? we'll need to rewrap keys and update service-account bindings that reference key ARNs.
marta: When rotating, ensure audit logs capture key version IDs and rewrap operations. Ops has a preview script: `scripts/kms/rewrap.sh --org 42 --preview` — use that first.
dan: I'll run the preview and validate there are no cross-org unwraps. If preview shows any unwraps outside org 42, we abort.
alex: Plan: 1) freeze role changes 2) run migration preview 3) rotate suspicious KMS alias 4) run full migration with canary orgs. Assignments: Dan -> preview + mapping patch, Priya -> KMS rotation, Marta -> audit ingestion rules.
priya: Ack. I'll schedule rotation 08:00 PT tomorrow and tag @infra-oncall.
marta: I'll add an eval rule to detect `binding.change` events where `project_id != intended_project` and emit a high-priority alert.
dan: Preview run started — found 7 bindings that would widen scope (listed by id). Pushing mapping patch to explicitly bind to `project:<id>` now.
alex: :thumbsup: After patch re-run and post results here. If anyone wants to sit with me during canary, meet in #eng-oncall.
infra-bot: Deploy started for audit-rule update (deploy-987). ETA ~4m.
priya: Rotation complete — rewrap reported 0 unwraps. KMS alias `rw-main-kms` now points to key version v3.
dan: Post-run: migration dry-run shows 0 widening changes after mapping patch. Looks safe for canary.
alex: Proceeding with canary on org 101 in 30m. Will post metrics and logs.
alex: Canary finished: no regressions, logs include pre/post binding states and actor. No cross-project reads observed. Rolling to remaining orgs in waves.
marta: Nice. Follow-ups: add unit test for mapping logic, add alert if mapping causes >N widened bindings, and record a short postmortem checklist.
priya: Also update the runbook with KMS rewrap troubleshooting and contact list for key-rotation rollback.
dan: Everything pushed. I'll monitor related alerts for the next 24h and report back if anything pops.
alex: Thanks all. Good catch on the svcacc mapping — that saved us from a likely blast radius.
